`src/rules/require-story-annotation.ts` - `meta.fixable: "code"` enables ESLint `--fix` for this rule. - Schema includes `annotationTemplate`, `methodAnnotationTemplate`, and `autoFix` options. - `create` resolves `annotationTemplate`, `methodAnnotationTemplate`, and `autoFix` (defaulting `autoFix` to true) and passes them into `buildVisitors`. - `src/rules/helpers/require-story-helpers.ts` - `getAnnotationTemplate` uses canonical `STORY_PATH` and allows override, implementing configurable templates. - `shouldApplyAutoFix` + `buildTemplateConfig` implement the `autoFix` toggle. - `reportMissing` / `reportMethod` delegate to `coreReportMissing` / `coreReportMethod` with these options, wiring templates and fix toggles. - `src/rules/helpers/require-story-core.ts` - `createAddStoryFix` and `createMethodFix` use `fixer.insertTextBeforeRange` with a single-line template and newline, touching only comment text and preserving surrounding code/indentation. - `getInsertionStart` carefully chooses insertion offset, including export wrappers, and falls back safely, changing no executable code. - `coreReportMissing` and `coreReportMethod` attach `fix` only when `allowFix` is true, but always provide `suggest` blocks describing the fix template. - `tests/rules/auto-fix-behavior-008.test.ts` - Verifies added annotations for: - Function declarations, function expressions, class methods, TS `declare` functions, and TS method signatures (all using a fixed template path). - `src/rules/helpers/valid-annotation-options.ts` - Options type `AnnotationRuleOptions` includes `autoFix?: boolean`. - `ResolvedAnnotationOptions` includes `autoFix: boolean` with default `true`. - `resolveAutoFixFlag` sets `autoFix` to `true` unless explicitly `false`. - `src/rules/helpers/valid-annotation-format-validators.ts` - `validateStoryAnnotation`: - Accepts valid paths via `options.storyPattern`. - On invalid but whitespace-containing values, reports error without fix. - Calls `getFixedStoryPath(collapsed)` and, if that result matches `storyPattern` and `options.autoFix !== false`, calls `reportInvalidStoryFormatWithFix`. - If `autoFix === false`, it calls `reportInvalidStoryFormat` (no fix), satisfying selective disabling. - `createStoryFix` computes an exact replacement range for the story value inside the comment, and returns `null` if it cannot safely locate the tag or value range. - `reportInvalidStoryFormatWithFix` falls back to non-fix reporting when `createStoryFix` returns `null`, ensuring safety and graceful failure. - `src/rules/valid-annotation-format.ts` - `meta.fixable: "code"` enables ESLint `--fix`. - Uses `resolveOptions(context.options || [])`, so the `autoFix` option flows into `ResolvedAnnotationOptions`. - The rule’s JSDoc explicitly ties fixability to Story 008.0 and REQ-AUTOFIX-SAFE / REQ-AUTOFIX-PRESERVE. - `tests/rules/auto-fix-behavior-008.test.ts` (second describe block): - `[REQ-AUTOFIX-FORMAT] already-correct story path is unchanged` confirms no-op behavior when suffix is already valid. - traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for Story 008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX are implemented and verified: - ESLint `--fix` provides auto-fix for missing `@story` on functions/methods and for simple @story path suffix issues via `require-story-annotation` and `valid-annotation-format`. - Fixes are conservative and non-destructive, preserving formatting and only touching annotation comments or suffixes. - Rule options implement configurable templates and per-rule auto-fix toggles, with tests confirming both enabled and disabled behaviors. - Behavior is integrated and exercised through ESLint’s RuleTester, and full test suite passes. - User-facing API reference documents the new auto-fix capabilities and configuration, matching the story’s documentation requirement.
